"""Backend API integration tests — group_run core behaviors (PRD §5.1–§5.5).

All tests receive the scaffold-provided ``client`` fixture (FastAPI TestClient
bound in-process).  No test constructs its own client or imports the app
entry module.  Each test is order-independent: it creates its own fixture
data through the public API.
"""


def test_create_run_success(client):
    """POST /runs with a valid payload → 201, generated id, submitted fields echoed."""
    payload = {
        "title": "Saturday Morning Run",
        "datetime": "2025-01-18T08:00:00",
        "meeting_location": "Central Park Gate 5",
        "distance": "5K",
        "pace_target": "9:00-10:00/mi",
        "route_notes": "Follow the lake loop",
    }
    resp = client.post("/runs", json=payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    body = resp.json()
    assert "id" in body and body["id"]
    assert body["title"] == "Saturday Morning Run"
    assert body["datetime"] == "2025-01-18T08:00:00"
    assert body["meeting_location"] == "Central Park Gate 5"
    assert body["distance"] == "5K"
    assert body["pace_target"] == "9:00-10:00/mi"
    assert body["route_notes"] == "Follow the lake loop"
    assert body["participants"] == []


def test_create_run_missing_required(client):
    """POST /runs with empty title → 422 validation_error envelope."""
    resp = client.post("/runs", json={
        "title": "",
        "datetime": "2025-01-18T08:00:00",
        "meeting_location": "Central Park Gate 5",
    })
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"


def test_list_runs(client):
    """Create a run, then GET /runs includes it with correct summary fields."""
    create = client.post("/runs", json={
        "title": "List Test Run",
        "datetime": "2025-02-01T07:00:00",
        "meeting_location": "Riverside Trail",
    })
    assert create.status_code == 201
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    resp = client.get("/runs")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    runs = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(runs, list) and len(runs) >= 1
    match = [r for r in runs if r["id"] == run_id]
    assert len(match) == 1
    assert match[0]["title"] == "List Test Run"
    assert match[0]["datetime"] == "2025-02-01T07:00:00"
    assert match[0]["meeting_location"] == "Riverside Trail"
    assert match[0]["participant_count"] == 0


def test_get_run_detail(client):
    """GET /runs/{id} returns the full Run object including participants list."""
    create = client.post("/runs", json={
        "title": "Detail Run",
        "datetime": "2025-03-01T09:00:00",
        "meeting_location": "Hilltop Park",
    })
    assert create.status_code == 201
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    resp = client.get(f"/runs/{run_id}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == run_id
    assert body["title"] == "Detail Run"
    assert body["datetime"] == "2025-03-01T09:00:00"
    assert body["meeting_location"] == "Hilltop Park"
    assert "participants" in body
    assert isinstance(body["participants"], list)


def test_get_run_not_found(client):
    """GET /runs/nonexistent → 404 run_not_found envelope."""
    resp = client.get("/runs/nonexistent")
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["error"]["code"] == "run_not_found"


def test_join_run_success(client):
    """POST /runs/{id}/join with a valid name → 201, participant in list."""
    create = client.post("/runs", json={
        "title": "Join Run",
        "datetime": "2025-04-01T06:30:00",
        "meeting_location": "Lake Shore",
    })
    assert create.status_code == 201
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Alice"})
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == run_id
    assert "Alice" in body["participants"]


def test_join_run_duplicate(client):
    """Second join with same name → 409 duplicate_participant envelope."""
    create = client.post("/runs", json={
        "title": "Dup Run",
        "datetime": "2025-05-01T07:00:00",
        "meeting_location": "Pine Trail",
    })
    assert create.status_code == 201
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    first = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Bob"})
    assert first.status_code == 201

    second = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Bob"})
    assert second.status_code == 409
    body = second.json()
    assert body["error"]["code"] == "duplicate_participant"


def test_join_run_empty_name(client):
    """Join with empty name → 422 validation_error envelope."""
    create = client.post("/runs", json={
        "title": "Empty Join Run",
        "datetime": "2025-06-01T08:00:00",
        "meeting_location": "Maple Ave",
    })
    assert create.status_code == 201
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": ""})
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"


def test_leave_run_success(client):
    """Join then leave → 200, participant removed, removed field set."""
    create = client.post("/runs", json={
        "title": "Leave Run",
        "datetime": "2025-07-01T05:30:00",
        "meeting_location": "Oak Grove",
    })
    assert create.status_code == 201
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    join = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Carol"})
    assert join.status_code == 201
    assert "Carol" in join.json()["participants"]

    leave = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/leave", json={"name": "Carol"})
    assert leave.status_code == 200
    body = leave.json()
    assert body["id"] == run_id
    assert "Carol" not in body["participants"]
    assert body["removed"] == "Carol"


def test_leave_run_not_found(client):
    """Leave with a name not on the run → 404 run_not_found envelope."""
    create = client.post("/runs", json={
        "title": "Leave NF Run",
        "datetime": "2025-08-01T06:00:00",
        "meeting_location": "Birch Path",
    })
    assert create.status_code == 201
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/leave", json={"name": "Nonexistent"})
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["error"]["code"] == "run_not_found"


def test_leave_run_empty_name(client):
    """Leave with empty name → 422 validation_error envelope."""
    create = client.post("/runs", json={
        "title": "Empty Leave Run",
        "datetime": "2025-09-01T07:30:00",
        "meeting_location": "Willow Bend",
    })
    assert create.status_code == 201
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/leave", json={"name": ""})
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"
